condition.name: glucose_anaerobic
condition.notes: Glucose uptake 10 mmol gDW^-1 h^-1, oxygen closed. Same condition as the e_coli_core examples, so the two scales are comparable.

brief:
- No single knockout or knockdown in this model produces any D-lactate at all: all 2526 of them measure 0.0000. The design needs at least two edits together.
- One pair that works is deleting ATPS4rpp and ALCD2x, which reaches about 17.6.
- A move that buys nothing on its own may still be the first half of a design. Do not judge a move only by the product change it causes.
